name: mayan_bats
description: Bats roosting in the vault of an old palace: a few high chirps, and now and then the soft flutter of wings.
character: Bats roosting in the vault of an old palace: a few high chirps, and now and then the soft flutter of wings.
note: A roost heard from the floor of a vault. Calls are audible social calls (under 20 kHz); echolocation is ultrasonic and is not rendered. Levels, rates and the flutter envelope are ESTIMATES; nothing here was auditioned.
